'''Stephen L. Trokel''' (born 1934) is an American [[ophthalmology|eye surgeon]], known for his contributions in creating and applying [[excimer laser]]s in [[cornea|corneal]] [[refractive surgery]].<ref name=Goes2013>{{cite book |last1=Goes |first1=Frank Joseph |editor1-last=Goes |editor1-first=Frank Joseph |title=The Eye in History |date=2013 |publisher=JP Medical Ltd |location=New Delhi |isbn=978-93-5090-274-5 |page=13 |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=v0oL8xDJ0VEC&pg=PA13 |language=en |chapter=1. Famous ophthalmologists}}</ref><ref name=Rockman2020>{{cite book |last1=Rockman |first1=Howard B. |title=Intellectual Property Law for Engineers, Scientists, and Entrepreneurs |date=2020 |publisher=John Wiley & Sons |isbn=978-1-119-38197-6 |page=656 |edition=2nd |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=K4fCDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA656 |language=en |chapter=Inventors and inventions}}</ref><ref name="D'Angelo2012">{{cite book |last1=D'Angelo |first1=John |title=Ethics in Science: Ethical Misconduct in Scientific Research |date=2012 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-1-4398-4086-3 |page=79 |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-LyhOTEzWEkC&pg=PA79  |language=en |chapter=8. Case studies}}</ref><ref name=Krueger2010>{{cite journal |last1=Krueger |first1=Ronald R. |last2=Rabinowitz |first2=Yaron S. |last3=Binder |first3=Perry S. |title=The 25th Anniversary of Excimer Lasers in Refractive Surgery: Historical Review |journal=Journal of Refractive Surgery |date=October 2010 |volume=26 |issue=10 |pages=749–760 |doi=10.3928/1081597X-20100921-01 |pmid=20954683 |url=https://journals.healio.com/doi/10.3928/1081597X-20100921-01|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
